Survey Information:
You are invited to participate in a research study conducted as part of a bachelor thesis in Marketing at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam.

The purpose of this study is to examine how people evaluate online product information and how this influences their perceptions and decisions.

It will take approximately 3-5 minutes to complete.



Your participation is voluntary, and you may stop at any time without penalty.



Your responses are anonymous. No identifying information will be collected. All data will be stored securely and used only for academic research purposes.

You must be 18 years or older to participate.



If you have any questions about the study, you can contact the researcher at: i.s.beukering@student.vu.nl
